title: Process-Heat-RDM: Proof of Concept for Decision-Centred Modelling (DCM)
description: Authoritative proof-of-concept for Decision-Centred Modelling (DCM). Demonstrates a site-to-region industrial process-heat decision (electric-boiler vs biomass-boiler pathways) at Fonterra Edendale, Southland, New Zealand, evaluated across 100 paired futures under deep uncertainty. Numerical results are illustrative of the method under declared low-to-medium-maturity scope conditions and are not calibrated operational guidance.
